method: Read 1000 additional contiguous source lines; source-level qualification of upstream tests and Windows helper contracts. No runtime controls executed in this batch.
findings: Hybrid accuracy test prints Rust Hit@3 but iterates every item returned by engine.search(q,3), without take(3). The already-read search implementation expands generic candidates to at least 2000 before further additions. Its >=70 percent assertion is therefore not proof of first-three ranking accuracy. No measured hit rate is reported here because the test was not executed.

Hybrid test sets global DISABLE_LIVE_RESULTS true without restoration; other parallel tests can observe that shared state. It also uses fixed test_db.db, shared with another test. Isolation requires further qualification before interpreting full-suite results.

Model path search in hybrid accuracy test discards model_path via let _ and does not load it there. The name hybrid and path lookup are not evidence of current embedding-model inference; previously reviewed ranking is lexical.

test_search_file opens APPDATA/omnisearch-lite/file_index.db or relative file_index.db, creates SearchEngine and prints resume search results without an expected-result assertion. It is an environment-dependent diagnostic, not a synthetic correctness regression. Not run against user data.
Windows AppsFolder enumeration test unwraps COM operations, prints at most ten entries and has no catalog-content assertion. It is not portable algorithm coverage and was not executed.

Live disk-space helper passes a null directory to GetDiskFreeSpaceExW while labeling result Disk Space (C:). Source does not select C explicitly. Exact platform semantics and observed drive mismatch remain unqualified; no Windows API was invoked.

Live IP helper binds a UDP socket and connects to a fixed destination to obtain local_addr; no such networking performed in review. Keyword matching uses substring ip rather than a word boundary, so unrelated queries may invoke this helper if live results are enabled.

Recent-file scan sorts shortcut modification times and truncates to 200 before target resolution/type filtering. It does not establish an exhaustive latest-200 useful-document set, verify target existence or dedupe targets in that helper. Enumeration/metadata failures silently drop entries.

Lite shortcut resolution uses a fixed 260-u16 buffer and trims surrounding whitespace from returned targets. Long-path and whitespace-bearing-path behavior need Windows fixtures, not assumed correct from string conversion.

Lite app scan sorts and dedupes by exact display name; distinct launch commands with the same display name collapse. Broad English substring exclusions such as help/manual/about can omit applications by label. This is launcher catalog curation, not file-content deduplication.

COM initialization results are ignored and no matching CoUninitialize appears in the reviewed scan_recent_files/scan_apps helper bodies. Caller/thread lifetime and practical leak impact remain unqualified.
Quick-action table in this batch contains command descriptors and external links only. No system action, browser navigation, clipboard operation or user-file mutation was performed.
limits: No new runtime tests. Original isolated NLP result remains 2 passed from v29; database/Windows test bodies read here are not counted as passes.
155/500 complete repository reviews unchanged. Native pHash/ASAN remains deferred; all-case goal incomplete.
